body: Benign fine-tuning severely weakens the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs), so we study why refusal behavior is so fragile. While prior work often attributes this failure to gradient conflict, we propose a fundamentally different Fisher-geometric explanation: safety Fisher is low-rank, and alignment makes the safety geometry flatter while preserving an output-routing pathway. After 100 benign fine-tuning examples, this pathway is selectively re-sharpened in output-side MLP modules, explaining the asymmetric fragility: safety can collapse to high attack success rates, while general utility degrades mildly. The routing view also explains why few safety examples can restore refusal behavior, indicating that internal safety-relevant representations are preserved. Finally, we show that LoRA and ASAM mitigate early collapse by suppressing output-side sharpness, but their protection weakens at larger fine-tuning scales. Overall, safety failure is best understood as a disruption of a low-rank output-routing mechanism
summaryZh: 本文深入探讨了良性微调导致大语言模型安全对齐失效的现象，提出了基于Fisher几何的解释。研究发现，安全对齐在模型内部表现为低秩的输出路由机制，而微调过程会使安全相关的几何结构变平，导致输出侧MLP模块重新强化了非安全路径。这种不对称的脆弱性解释了为何少量微调即可破坏安全防御。研究进一步指出，LoRA等方法在一定程度上能缓解该问题，但随微调规模扩大保护效果会减弱，为提升模型鲁棒性提供了关键视角。

glossary.explanationZh: 指模型经过微调后，原有的安全对齐约束容易被破坏的特性。
基于Fisher信息矩阵的几何分析方法，用于理解模型参数空间的分布特性。
模型内部决定输出内容流向的特定神经通路。
指矩阵或几何结构的秩较低，通常意味着其包含的信息维度有限。
指在非安全相关的任务上对模型进行的常规微调。
